acceptanceCriteria.text: Feature remains skill id `ws-wiki`. No new packaged skill folder `ws-wiki-from-code`. `CATALOG.md` / runtime catalog rows stay one `ws-wiki` skill and mention from-code genesis.

tests.name: AC2: body outputs load banner "ws-wiki loaded."

acceptanceCriteria.text: `.agents/skills/ws-wiki/SKILL.md` is a router: subcommand table, aliases, and load-on-demand pointers only. Full procedures live in the companion files named in Description.

Companions `INIT.md`, `FROM-CODE.md`, `PHASE-1-SWEEP.md`, `PHASE-2-VERIFY.md`, `PHASE-3-APPLY.md`, `SYNC.md`, and `UPDATE.md` exist under `.agents/skills/ws-wiki/`. Each is loaded only when that subcommand is invoked. SKILL.md links to them. SKILL.md still names `/ws-wiki sweep`, `/ws-wiki verify` (`audit`, `check-code`), `/ws-wiki apply` (`reconcile`, `phase-3`), `/ws-wiki sync`, and `/ws-wiki from-code` (`reverse`, `reconstruct`).

tests.name: AC4: SKILL documents verify enumerator usage

acceptanceCriteria.text: Moving 0076/0078 procedures into companions does not change sweep overlay order, current-code bias, verify classification, Phase 3 truth gates, or `ws-spec-write` code-handoff behavior except as this spec adds from-code and the init offer.

tests.name: NS1: SKILL router documents missing-index STOP

acceptanceCriteria.text: `/ws-wiki from-code` without `index.wiki.md` STOP with a message to run `/ws-wiki init` first; it does not invent an index or feature pages.

tests.name: from-code helper JSON ok is true
NS7: empty frontend recorded in skipped

acceptanceCriteria.text: Helper `.agents/skills/ws-wiki/scripts/list_wiki_from_code_areas.cjs` prints `--json` `{ ok, areas: [{ id, title, paths }], errors }` for the canonical area ids. An area with no existing candidate paths is omitted from `areas` and recorded in `errors` or a `skipped` array (not invented). Sort is the canonical id order in Description.

tests.name: NS8: from-code helper performs no network fetch

acceptanceCriteria.text: Helper CLI validates `--repo-root` with directory containment (resolved path stays under repo root); unknown flags and leftover argv tokens are rejected before walking the tree; `--help` exits 0 and is never a filename. Helper does not call SCM HTTP.

tests.name: git-surface always in areas with paths: []

acceptanceCriteria.text: Candidate paths include `config.json` stack layer / `srcDir` / `sourceDir` values when those directories exist, plus convention hits for CI, docs, tests, and `{reviewsDir}` when configured. `git-surface` contributes no filesystem tree requirement; the agent uses local git commands only as specified (last 20 commits, branch names from `config.project`).

tests.name: AC9: FROM-CODE documents merge start gate
NS6: FROM-CODE documents overwrite confirm gate

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start `user-gate` for from-code: recommended Start merge reconstruction vs Cancel. When feature pages already exist, merge is the default; a separate overwrite confirm is required before deleting or replacing existing wiki statements. Cancel STOP writes no `from-code.state.json`. `autoMode` takes merge.

tests.name: NS5: FROM-CODE documents merge preserve rules

acceptanceCriteria.text: Sequential walk is one area at a time. Merge mode creates missing domain/feature pages and fills empty 3-section headings from code/docs; it does not drop existing Business Rules or Architecture statements. Overwrite mode (after confirm) may replace page bodies but still writes 3-section pages and then `sync_wiki_index.cjs`.

Checkpoint `{wikiDir}/from-code.state.json` records `status` (`running` | `completed`), `completedAreas`, `lastArea`, `mode` (`merge` | `overwrite`), `startedAt`, `updatedAt`. `--resume` continues after `lastArea` unless `--force`. Agents must not stage this file in product commits.
`--dry-run` prints the area queue (and checkpoint summary if present) and writes neither wiki pages nor `from-code.state.json`.

tests.name: AC2: PHASE-1 documents post-sweep Phase 2 offer

acceptanceCriteria.text: After a successful from-code finish, present `user-gate` Run Phase 2 wiki-vs-code audit (Recommended) vs Skip. Skip writes no verify artifacts. Cancel STOP. `autoMode` takes recommended.

tests.name: AC14: INIT recommends from-code when zero specs
AC14: INIT recommends sweep when specs exist

acceptanceCriteria.text: After successful `init`, if the helper/spec enumerator reports **zero** top-level specs, the init `user-gate` recommends from-code reconstruction; spec sweep remains an option. If one or more specs exist, sweep remains recommended and from-code merge is offered as a non-recommended option.

tests.name: NS8: from-code helper performs no network fetch

acceptanceCriteria.text: From-code does not mutate product source, does not call `ws-spec-write`, and does not register `{plansDir}`. Finish still runs `validate_wiki.cjs --check`.

`test/test-wiki.js` (or sibling `test/test-wiki-from-code.js` listed in `package.json` test scripts) covers AC6–AC7, AC12 dry-run, missing-index STOP copy or skill contract test, empty-area skip, containment/unknown-flag failures, companion file presence, and SKILL/CATALOG strings for `/ws-wiki from-code`. Existing sweep/verify SKILL string tests still pass via the router table.

tests.name: AC18: no host product names in skill router
NS8: from-code helper performs no network fetch

acceptanceCriteria.text: No host/IDE product names in skill body, companions, gates, or scripts (portable `user-gate` / `askQuestion` alias only).

tests.name: AC18: CATALOG mentions Phase 2 wiki-vs-code verify

acceptanceCriteria.text: Authoring validation for this specification exits 0.

negativeScenarios.text: Missing `index.wiki.md`: `/ws-wiki from-code` STOP; helper may still list areas; skill must not write feature pages.

tests.name: NS2: paths escaping repo root are not collected

negativeScenarios.text: `--repo-root` resolving outside the intended tree: helper exit non-zero, no walk of the escaped path.
Unknown argv token / leftover `--help` as path: `--help` exit 0; other dash tokens non-zero.
`--dry-run` after a partial checkpoint: no wiki mtime/content change, no new checkpoint write.

tests.name: NS5: FROM-CODE documents merge preserve rules

negativeScenarios.text: Merge mode on an existing page that already has a business rule: that rule remains in the file after the run.

tests.name: NS6: FROM-CODE documents overwrite confirm gate

negativeScenarios.text: Overwrite without the extra confirm: no existing feature page body replaced.

tests.name: NS7: empty frontend omitted from areas

negativeScenarios.text: Empty frontend `sourceDir`: `frontend` omitted from `areas`; run still succeeds.

tests.name: NS8: from-code helper performs no network fetch

negativeScenarios.text: Unauthenticated network calls: N/A because from-code does not call SCM HTTP; a regression that adds unauthenticated remote fetch for from-code must not ship.
